subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Ler e compreender, com autonomia, cartas dirigidas a veículos da mídia impressa ou digital (cartas de leitor e de reclamação a jornais, revistas) e notícias, dentre outros gêneros do campo jornalístico, de acordo com as convenções do gênero carta e considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto do texto.

components.description_pt: Ler e compreender independentemente cartas de leitores e cartas de reclamação dirigidas a meios de comunicação
components.description_en: Read and independently comprehend reader letters and complaint letters addressed to media outlets
components.cc_component_description: Read and comprehend grade 6–8 literary nonfiction texts independently and proficiently

components.description_pt: Ler e compreender independentemente artigos de notícias considerando situação comunicativa e tema
components.description_en: Read and independently comprehend news articles considering the communicative situation and topic
components.cc_component_description: Read and comprehend grade 6–8 literary nonfiction texts independently and proficiently

components.description_pt: Identificar propósito comunicativo e argumento principal em carta dirigida a veículo de mídia
components.description_en: Identify the communicative purpose and main argument in a letter addressed to a media outlet
components.cc_component_description: Identify the main purpose of an informational text

components.description_pt: Reconhecer convenções estruturais do gênero carta em contextos jornalísticos e cívicos
components.description_en: Recognize the structural conventions of the letter genre in journalistic and civic contexts
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how a text's structural choices support the reader's understanding of the topic

cc_matches.description: By the end of the year, read and comprehend literary nonfiction in the grades 6—8 text complexity band proficiently, with scaffolding as needed at the high end of the range.
Identify the main purpose of a text, including what the author wants to answer, explain, or describe.
Analyze the structure an author uses to organize a text, including how the major sections contribute to the whole and to an understanding of the topic.
